_about: Story progress for Bible Stories. The weekly run reads this to know what is done and what comes next, and updates it after each release. Shelf data shown on the site lives in js/stories.js; chapter sources in tools/stories/<id>.js; the leaderboard list in netlify/functions/leaderboard.mjs (STORIES). Only released stories go into js/stories.js (with added:'<Monday>'); everything else waits here.

weekly_plan.volume: 2 new characters + 1 new event every Monday, chapters to fit each story (up to 4, never padded) - Dawn, Nov 28 2026 (replaces 4 characters a week)
weekly_plan.joseph_slot: finishing a character already on the shelf counts as one of the 2 character slots (Joseph ch 4-5 on Dec 7) - Dawn, Nov 28 2026
weekly_plan.shelf: only released stories show; no greyed coming-soon cards; 'New this week' for 7 days; the library only grows - Dawn, Nov 28 2026
weekly_plan.never_run_out: keep adding characters and events from across the Bible to the waiting list
weekly_plan.release_day: Monday; the week runs Monday-Sunday CT, like the Weekly Scheduler
weekly_plan.auto_go_live: yes, once all three checks pass (Dawn, Nov 27 2026)
weekly_plan.first_release: launch Mon Nov 30 2026 9:00 AM CT (Joseph 1-3, Christmas); first weekly release Mon Dec 7 2026

joseph.note: Genesis 38 is about Judah, not Joseph, so it is not one of the Joseph chapters. Chapters 4-5 finish Joseph's story (Dec 7 2026); after them his card has no 'more'.

david.status: chapters 1-4 built, live Mon 2026-12-07 9:00 AM CT
david.later: David the king (2 Samuel) can come back as a returning character

christmas.content_choices: no wings on angels, no star over the manger, no donkey or stable animals (not in the text), the wise men visit a house (Matthew 2:11), their number is not given in Scripture

noah.content_choices: God is a voice and light, never drawn; the flood is shown as rain and rising water around the ark, no one shown drowning; clean beasts by sevens is mentioned so the 'two by two' is not misread

returning_characters: A character can come back in a later week with new chapters that continue the story (for example David's later years, Paul's journeys).

2026-12-07.status: built and checked; on the shelf from Mon Dec 7 9:00 AM CT (added-date gate in js/stories.js), so it can go out in an earlier batch push
